data:
PrepareDev.Spec.applied_at_most_once : ∀ (s : PrepareDev.Spec.State),
  PrepareDev.Spec.Reachable s →
    (∀ (a : PrepareDev.Spec.AnswerId), (s.committedIntentsOf a).length ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ (d : PrepareDev.Spec.Decision),
          d ∈ s.publicDecisions →
            ∃ i,
              i ∈ s.committedIntents ∧
                i.txid = d.txid ∧
                  i.decisionId = d.id ∧
                    ∀ (j : PrepareDev.Spec.Intent), j ∈ s.committedIntents → j.txid = d.txid → j = i) ∧
        (∀ (i : PrepareDev.Spec.Intent),
            i ∈ s.committedIntents → { id := i.decisionId, txid := i.txid } ∈ s.publicDecisions) ∧
          (∀ (i : PrepareDev.Spec.Intent),
              i ∈ s.committedIntents →
                ∀ (j : PrepareDev.Spec.Intent), j ∈ s.committedIntents → i.decisionId = j.decisionId → i = j) ∧
            ∀ (d : PrepareDev.Spec.Decision),
              d ∈ s.decisions → (d ∈ s.publicDecisions ↔ PrepareDev.Spec.hasCommit s.journal d.txid)

PrepareDev.Spec.committed_safety : ∀ (s : PrepareDev.Spec.State),
  PrepareDev.Spec.Reachable s →
    (∀ (i : PrepareDev.Spec.Intent),
        i ∈ s.committedIntents →
          ∃ a,
            a ∈ s.answers ∧
              a.id = i.answer ∧
                a.stale = false ∧
                  (∃ q, q ∈ s.questions ∧ q.id = a.question ∧ q.subjects = i.subjects) ∧
                    ∀ (q : PrepareDev.Spec.Question), q ∈ s.questions → q.id = a.question → q.subjects = i.subjects) ∧
      ∀ (s' : PrepareDev.Spec.State) (act : PrepareDev.Spec.Action) (r : PrepareDev.Spec.Result),
        PrepareDev.Spec.step s act = (s', r) →
          ∀ (tx : PrepareDev.Spec.TxId),
            PrepareDev.Spec.hasCommit s'.journal tx →
              ¬PrepareDev.Spec.hasCommit s.journal tx →
                s'.records = s.records ∧ ∃ i, i ∈ s'.intents ∧ i.txid = tx ∧ s.subjectsMatch i.subjects = true

PrepareDev.Spec.quiescent_with_answers : ∀ (s : PrepareDev.Spec.State),
  PrepareDev.Spec.Reachable s →
    (∀ (act : PrepareDev.Spec.Action) (a : PrepareDev.Spec.Answer),
        a ∈ s.answers → ∃ a', a' ∈ (PrepareDev.Spec.step s act).fst.answers ∧ a'.id = a.id) ∧
      (s.inflight = false →
        (∀ (a : PrepareDev.Spec.Answer), a ∈ s.answers → (a.appliedAs ≠ none ↔ s.committed a.id = true)) ∧
          (∀ (tx : PrepareDev.Spec.TxId),
              (∃ d, d ∈ s.decisions ∧ d.txid = tx) ↔ PrepareDev.Spec.hasCommit s.journal tx) ∧
            s.pendingFromFiles = s.pendingFromJournal)

PrepareDev.Recovery.recovery_safe : ∀ (s : PrepareDev.Recovery.Disk) (actions : List PrepareDev.Recovery.Action),
  (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions).answer = s.answer ∧
    PrepareDev.Recovery.ready (PrepareDev.Recovery.finish (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions)) = true ∧
      (PrepareDev.Recovery.ready (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions) = true →
          (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions).aborted = true ∧
            (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions).decision = false ∧
              (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions).applied = false ∧ (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions).stale = true) ∧
        (PrepareDev.Recovery.ready (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions) = true →
          PrepareDev.Recovery.resume (PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions) = PrepareDev.Recovery.run s actions)
